overall.summary: The single most striking page produced by either effort level: image-filled display type over a nocturnal temple facade, with 67 verification actions behind it. The best result in the matrix.

standards.summary: 2,469 lines but concentrated in only three files, one of which is a 1,319-line stylesheet. The engineering is sound; the file layout is not.

findings.title: Whole experience lives in three files
findings.detail: src/styles.css is 1,319 lines and the page logic sits in one module beside it. Nothing is broken, but each movement's type treatment, mask geometry and scroll behaviour are interleaved in one sheet, which makes an isolated change risky. Split by movement, as the sibling run did.

findings.title: Six Math.random sites in the ambience layer
findings.detail: Star and cloud placement is drawn from Math.random, so the composition differs on every load and a visual regression cannot be reproduced from a screenshot. Seed the generator.

strengths: 58 ARIA attributes, the highest density of the two elysian runs
67 verification actions: the most thoroughly checked run of the sixteen
localStorage used to remember the reader's position across the movements

specification.summary: The four images become the fill of the display letterforms and the substance of the facade behind them. This is the most complete answer to 'treat them as raw material' of anything produced here.
strengths: CLAUDE OPUS 5 set as image-filled type, with a different source image inside different letters
Nocturnal temple facade composed from the golden-temple and still-life sources
Four named hours (Hour, Matins, Meridian, Vespers) structure the navigation
Instruction to sweep the facade tells the reader the background is interactive

ux.summary: Immediate impact, then a clear invitation to interact. The interaction hint is the detail that separates this from a poster.

findings.title: Interaction hint is small and low-contrast
findings.detail: 'Sweep the facade, it is not solid' is the key affordance on the page and it renders at roughly 10px in muted amber. Raise its size or contrast so the interaction is discovered rather than stumbled on.

strengths: Image-filled type is legible at hero scale despite the complex fill
Serif body copy with an italic accent word carries the luxury register
Plate counter and edition number reward a second look
Works at desktop and mobile widths
